studyPolicy.description: Roads are ranked from most to least important: primary, then secondary, tertiary, unclassified, and residential or living-street roads; within a class, longer mapped roads rank higher, and equal lengths are ordered by name. The rank is the card order.
rankedBy: road class (primary, secondary, tertiary, unclassified, residential/living street)
studyPolicy.eligibility: Primary and secondary arterials, and tertiary collectors, with at least 90 mapped meters of that class inside Eugene. Residential/local roads are map context only.
studyPolicy.classification: Highest OSM road class with at least 90 mapped meters inside Eugene. Retained street names keep their full ward-clipped geometry.

provenance.geometry: OSM ways clipped to the exact official City Council ward polygons, preserving holes and disconnected segments. Source vertices and clipped intersections retain full coordinate precision. No bounding-box street assignment, coordinate rounding or line simplification. Lengths measured on a sphere of mean Earth radius 6371008.8 m.

boundaries.geometry: Unmodified WGS84 official City Council ward polygons (E1–E8).
boundaries.limitation: The official layer covers only land inside the City of Eugene; ward boundaries are the retrieval snapshot and can change at redistricting.

provenance.limitations: OSM coverage and names are community maintained. Only the listed road classes are included; service roads, parking aisles, footways and other path classes are intentionally excluded. Rivers are mapped river centerlines, not water-surface polygons. The Overpass snapshot timestamp dates OSM data; the official boundary source does not expose a matching historical snapshot.
